question: How many stores do we have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_stores FROM stores;

question: List all brand names in our catalog.
sql: SELECT brand_name FROM brands ORDER BY brand_name;

question: Give me Top 3 best selling products from California.
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, c.state, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.list_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.state = 'CA' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3;

chart.title: Top 3 products in California by revenue
